attestations.text: HUI Tung 惠棟 (T. 定宇, H. 松崖), Nov. 18, 1697–1758, June 17 or 27, scholar, native of Yüan-ho (Soochow), was the second son of Hui Shih-ch'i [q. v.]. He studied under his father and graduated as licentiate in 1716.
